entities.summary: Jason Jerrod Bourgeois is an American former professional baseball outfielder who currently serves as the first base coach for the Baltimore Orioles of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played eight seasons in MLB, primarily for the Houston Astros and the Cincinnati Reds.
